file_reviews.assessment: Package description, reproduction steps, and mathematical scope of L1-native cohomology package read. Confirms finite graph boundary.
Full manuscript read. Section 2 establishes Theorem LpC-T1 (quotient attainment via gauge-fixed coercivity) and Theorem LpC-T2 (quotient norm axioms on Q^1).
Ledger entries read. Line 13 LpC-T1 and line 15 LpC-T2 record classical propositions with proofs supplied in manuscript Section 2.

Full implementation read. DirectedGraph validates strictly positive weights and connectivity; ExactTwoPhaseSimplexSolver, ExactRationalL2LaplacianSolver, and ExactRationalLinfChebyshevSolver compute exact rational quotient norms; HighPrecisionLpConvexSolver performs interior Lp optimization.
Lean 4 mechanization read. Formalizes gauge_fixed_kernel_trivial and l1c_t01_coercivity_bound on the integer 3-cycle model with zero axioms.
Lean 4 mechanization read. Formalizes l1_norm3_nonneg, l1_norm3_triangle, l1_quotient_subadditive, l1_norm3_positive_definite, and zero_weight_refusal_counterexample with zero axioms.

claims.statement: For a finite graph with strictly positive edge weights and p in [1, inf], the quotient infimum inf_f ||c - df||_{p,w} is attained.
dependencies: Finite connected graph with positive edge weights.
Gauge-fixed complement decomposition C^0 = F + ker d_0.
Weierstrass extreme value theorem on compact sublevel sets.
claims.limits: Applies to finite graphs with strictly positive weights; does not claim infinite complexes or continuous manifolds.

claims.statement: The quotient functional Phi_p([c]) = inf_f ||c - df||_{p,w} defines a valid norm on the quotient space Q^1 = C^1 / im d_0 for all p in [1, inf] under strictly positive weights.
dependencies: Finite graph with strictly positive edge weights.
Subadditivity via representative addition and positive definiteness via positive edge weights.
claims.limits: Applies to finite graphs with strictly positive weights; permitting a zero weight violates positive definiteness.
